title: A Man Wakes Up Inside A Fake Family Built To Make Him Confess A Murder . . . (Forgotten)
caption:
Forgotten (2017): a young man is kidnapped and hypnotized until he believes a stranger's family is his own. Behind the perfect home is a trap meant to dig out one night he forgot 😳

#forgotten #kmovie #movierecap #spoilerroom #fyp
comment: Was Jack a victim or a killer in the end? Why?

segments.say: A man is tied to a chair in a basement, and told the family he loves is all *fake*.
To see how it got here, go back to the day Jack's family *moved house*.
Jack rides to their new house with Mom, Dad, and his big brother Mike.
Mike is the golden boy. Top of his class, great at sports, loved by *everyone*.
Jack adores him, but he lives in his *shadow*. Then the new house starts making noise.
That night at dinner, something heavy falls in the room right above their *heads*.
Mom and Dad laugh it off. Probably *thunder*. Jack is not buying it.
In bed, he keeps hearing strange sounds from that room, and nobody else *does*.
Mike tells him he just doesn't want to *study*.
Then, one rainy night on a hill, Dad phones Jack and asks him to fetch a *document*.
Jack tells Mike to wait. Ten minutes, tops.
But when he gets back, two men are shoving Mike into a black *van*.
Jack screams his brother's name into the rain.
Jack chases it through the rain until he falls to his *knees*.
All he caught was the license *plate*.
Jack passes out. He wakes up to Mom begging him to say what happened to her other *son*.
Detectives arrive, and Jack swears he saw a black *van*.
But that plate does not exist. They tried every number *close* to it.

segments.text: I said, "07JO8911." It was a black van!

segments.say: Even his own dad tells them Jack isn't *well*. Nobody believed him.
Jack takes his pills and tries to rest, but every night he dreams of the same *man*.
Days later, Mike walks back through the front door, alive and *smiling*.
He remembers nothing. The doctor says the shock wiped his *memory*.
Everyone cries with joy. Jack just *stares* at him.
Something is off. Mike limped on his left leg for twenty years. Now it's his *right*.
A stranger was wearing his brother's face.
So Jack follows him one night, and even jumps in a taxi. Follow that car!
But Mike disappears into a maze of dark alleys, and Jack is left *alone*.
Then two men spot him and chase him through the closed *shops*.
Next morning, he grabs Mike and screams that men chased him.
Mike stays calm. None of that ever happened, he says. It was all in your *head*.
Jack screams that this man is not his *brother*.
But Mom is not on his side. Later she whispers into the phone, passing along everything Jack *said*.
Jack hears all of it. Nothing in that house was *real*.
That night he sneaks out, but Dad is waiting at the gate. Where are you going?
Jack runs into the rain, and stumbles into a police *station*.
He tells the officer a gang has held him for over a *month*.
Then the officer asks his age. Twenty-one, Jack says. It's 1997.
The officer points at the calendar. It's 2017, and Jack is *forty-one*. Twenty years, gone just like that.
Then the people who took him finally show their *faces*.
They tell him about December twentieth, 1997, when a family was killed in their own *home*.
The police never found the killer, and the case was forgotten once the time limit ran *out*.
But the family never forgot. They dug the case up again, and finally found the man who ruined their *lives*.
They caught him, but he swore he remembered *nothing*.
So they hired a hypnosis expert to dig the memory out of his *head*.
The expert said the killer had blocked that whole night out of his own *mind*.
They put him to sleep and told him it was 1997, and that his family was driving him to their new *house*.
Mom, Dad and Mike were actors. The house was built to match the murder scene, down to the last *detail*.
Even the song that played the night of the murder was on the *stereo*. Cruel, but clever.
They only had to wait for rain, and stage the same night again.
But the spell started wearing off, and Jack grew *suspicious*.
In the car, they say he'll die the most painful way there is. Jack swears he is *innocent*.
Then he throws himself out of the car, and runs for his *life*.
They hunt him through the night streets until he ends up bleeding in an operating *room*.
And as he fights to live, the memory finally cracks open.
Twenty years ago, Jack was a broke kid with a brother in a hospital *bed*.
He begged every lender in town. Then a stranger in a chat room made him an *offer*.

segments.text: You'll get paid for killing someone...

segments.say: He needed the money so badly he never asked *why*.
Jack hit send. His orders were simple. Break in at night, and get rid of the *woman*.
But in the dark, everything went wrong. He told the little boy to hide under a blanket and *count*.
When the boy finished counting, the woman and the little girl were on the *floor*. Nobody walks away clean.
Then the memory ends. In the hospital, a man in a black suit walks in holding a *syringe*.
He leans in close and snarls, why didn't you kill that kid *too*?
Jack just lies there as the whole night comes back to *him*.
Soon after, the man in the suit is lying dead on the *pavement*.
Some nights you can never *forget*. Wonder what we spoil next?
